description: This file provides functions to fetch project cost data and cost history sum from a backend API, including handling of project ID validation and response parsing.

methods.name: getProjectCost
methods.description: Fetches the aggregated cost for a specific project by projectId, calling the /api/projects/:projectId/cost endpoint.

methods.name: getProjectCostHistorySum
methods.description: Fetches the total cost history sum for a project, accounting for granular deltas, by calling the /api/projects/:projectId/cost-history-sum endpoint.
